mapper.select: select exists (select 1 from sys_plant where plant_cd = #{plantCd})

select n.node_id, wms_node_path(n.node_id) as path, a.loc_usage from mst_equip_hier n join wms_loc_attr a on a.node_id = n.node_id where n.plant_cd = #{plantCd} and n.node_type = 'LOC' and a.loc_usage = 'STAGING' and n.use_yn = 'Y' order by path
select cust_id from mst_cust where cust_cd = #{custCd} and use_yn = 'Y' and cust_type in ('SALES', 'BOTH')
select 1 from (select pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('WMS_SHIP_OL:' || #{key}, 0))) x

select sl.order_line_id, sum(sl.qty) as qty from wms_ship_line sl join wms_ship s on s.ship_id = sl.ship_id where s.status in ('DRAFT', 'PICKING') and sl.order_line_id in #{id} group by sl.order_line_id
mapper.sql:
s.ship_id, s.ship_no, s.plant_cd, s.cust_id, c.cust_cd, c.cust_nm, s.stage_node_id, wms_node_path(s.stage_node_id) as stage_path, s.plan_date, s.status, s.remark, s.shipped_at, s.shipped_by, s.cancel_reason, s.row_ver, s.created_at, s.created_by,
tr.carrier_nm, tr.vehicle_no, tr.tracking_no, tr.row_ver as transport_row_ver, tr.updated_at as transport_at, tr.updated_by as transport_by, (select count(*) from wms_ship_line l where l.ship_id = s.ship_id) as line_count,
(select count(distinct n.note_id) from wms_ship_line l join mst_item i on i.item_id = l.item_id join wms_ship_note n on where l.ship_id = s.ship_id) as note_cnt, (select count(distinct n.note_id) from wms_ship_line l join mst_item i on i.item_id = l.item_id join wms_ship_note n on where l.ship_id = s.ship_id and n.ack_required_yn = 'Y' and s.status in ('DRAFT', 'PICKING') and not ) as note_open_cnt
mapper.select:
select order by
s.ship_no c.cust_cd s.status s.created_at s.plan_date
desc,
s.ship_id desc limit #{page.size} offset #{page.offset}
select count(*)
select from wms_ship s join mst_cust c on c.cust_id = s.cust_id left join wms_ship_transport tr on tr.ship_id = s.ship_id where s.ship_id = #{id}
select s.ship_id, s.ship_no, s.plant_cd, s.cust_id, s.stage_node_id, s.plan_date, s.status, s.row_ver from wms_ship s where s.ship_id = #{id} for update

select l.ship_line_id, l.line_no, l.order_line_id, l.item_id, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, i.unit_cd, i.lot_ctrl_yn, l.qty, coalesce((select sum(p.qty) from wms_ship_pick p where p.ship_line_id = l.ship_line_id and p.status in ('PICKED', 'SHIPPED')), 0) as picked_qty, coalesce((select sum(p.qty) from wms_ship_pick p where p.ship_line_id = l.ship_line_id and p.status = 'SHIPPED'), 0) as shipped_qty from wms_ship_line l join mst_item i on i.item_id = l.item_id where l.ship_id = #{id} order by l.line_no

select p.pick_id, p.ship_line_id, p.from_node_id, wms_node_path(p.from_node_id) as from_path, p.lot_id, (select m.lot_no from lot_master m where m.lot_id = p.lot_id) as lot_no, p.qty, p.status, p.created_at, p.created_by, p.pallet_id, (select t.pallet_no from wms_pallet t where t.pallet_id = p.pallet_id) as pallet_no from wms_ship_pick p join wms_ship_line l on l.ship_line_id = p.ship_line_id where l.ship_id = #{id} order by l.line_no, p.pick_id

insert into wms_ship (comp_cd, plant_cd, ship_no, cust_id, stage_node_id, plan_date, remark, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{plantCd}, #{shipNo}, #{custId}, #{stageNodeId}, #{planDate}, #{remark}, #{by}, #{by}) returning ship_id
mapper.insert: insert into wms_ship_line (comp_cd, ship_id, line_no, order_line_id, item_id, qty, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{shipId}, #{lineNo}, #{orderLineId}, #{itemId}, #{qty}, #{by}, #{by})
mapper.update: update wms_ship set status = #{to}, row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where ship_id = #{id} and status = #{from}
update wms_ship set status = 'SHIPPED', shipped_at = now(), shipped_by = #{by}, row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where ship_id = #{id} and status = 'PICKING'
update wms_ship set status = 'PICKING', shipped_at = null, shipped_by = null, row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where ship_id = #{id} and status = 'SHIPPED'
mapper.select: select r.rtn_no from wms_cust_rtn r where r.ship_id = #{id} and r.status = 'RECEIVED' order by r.rtn_id limit 1
mapper.update: update wms_ship set status = 'CANCELLED', cancel_reason = #{reason}, row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where ship_id = #{id} and status = 'DRAFT'
mapper.select: insert into wms_ship_pick (comp_cd, ship_line_id, from_node_id, lot_id, qty, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{shipLineId}, #{fromNodeId}, #{lotId}, #{qty}, #{by}, #{by}) returning pick_id

select p.pick_id, p.ship_line_id, l.order_line_id, l.item_id, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, i.unit_cd, p.lot_id, (select m.lot_no from lot_master m where m.lot_id = p.lot_id) as lot_no, p.qty, p.from_node_id, p.status, p.pallet_id, t.pallet_no, t.sscc from wms_ship_pick p join wms_ship_line l on l.ship_line_id = p.ship_line_id join mst_item i on i.item_id = l.item_id left join wms_pallet t on t.pallet_id = p.pallet_id where l.ship_id = #{shipId} and p.status = #{status} order by l.line_no, p.pick_id

select t.trx_id from inv_trx t where t.src_type = 'SHIP_PICK' and t.src_id = #{pickId} and t.trx_type = 'MOVE_OUT' and t.reversal_of_id is null and not exists (select 1 from inv_trx r where r.reversal_of_id = t.trx_id)

select t.trx_id, p.pick_id, l.order_line_id, t.qty from inv_trx t join wms_ship_pick p on p.pick_id = t.src_id join wms_ship_line l on l.ship_line_id = p.ship_line_id where t.src_type = 'SHIP_PICK' and t.trx_type = 'SHIP' and t.reversal_of_id is null and l.ship_id = #{shipId} and not exists (select 1 from inv_trx r where r.reversal_of_id = t.trx_id) order by t.trx_id
select lot_id from lot_master where item_id = #{itemId} and lot_no = #{lotNo}
select from (select #{nodeId}::bigint as node_id) s

select s.node_id, wms_node_path(s.node_id) as path, s.lot_id, lm.lot_no, s.qty, coalesce(lm.hold_yn, 'N') as hold_yn from inv_stock s left join lot_master lm on lm.lot_id = s.lot_id left join wms_loc_attr a on a.node_id = s.node_id where s.item_id = #{itemId} and s.plant_cd = #{plantCd} and s.qty > 0 and s.node_id <> #{stageNodeId} and
and s.node_id in ( with recursive sc as ( select node_id, 1 as lv from mst_equip_hier where node_id = #{nodeId} union all select c.node_id, sc.lv + 1 from sc join mst_equip_hier c on c.parent_id = sc.node_id where sc.lv < 20 ) select node_id from sc)
and s.lot_id = #{lotId} order by path, lm.lot_no nulls first limit 200

select t.pallet_id, t.pallet_no, t.sscc, t.status, t.closed_at, t.closed_by, t.row_ver, (select count(*) from wms_ship_pick p where p.pallet_id = t.pallet_id) as pick_count from wms_pallet t where t.ship_id = #{shipId} order by t.pallet_id

select t.pallet_id, t.pallet_no, t.sscc, t.status, t.row_ver, (select count(*) from wms_ship_pick p where p.pallet_id = t.pallet_id) as pick_count from wms_pallet t where t.pallet_id = #{palletId} and t.ship_id = #{shipId} for update
insert into wms_pallet (comp_cd, ship_id, pallet_no, remark, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{shipId}, #{palletNo}, #{remark}, #{by}, #{by}) returning pallet_id
mapper.update: update wms_ship set row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where ship_id = #{id}
mapper.select: select count(*) from wms_ship_pick p join wms_ship_line l on l.ship_line_id = p.ship_line_id left join wms_pallet t on t.pallet_id = p.pallet_id where l.ship_id = #{shipId} and p.status = 'PICKED' and (t.pallet_id is null or t.status <> 'CLOSED')

select l.item_id, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, i.unit_cd, sum(p.qty) as qty, count(distinct p.lot_id) as lot_count from wms_ship_pick p join wms_ship_line l on l.ship_line_id = p.ship_line_id join mst_item i on i.item_id = l.item_id where p.pallet_id = #{palletId} group by l.item_id, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, i.unit_cd order by i.item_cd
